newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Couple win court fight to marry.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Couple win court fight to marry.

text.p: A pregnant Australian teenager on Friday won the right to marry her boyfriend after taking her case to the highest court in Western Australia.
Seventeen-year-old Amie Willis, who is five-months pregnant, had planned to marry 22-year-old Adam Cooper this weekend, until a magistrate on Monday refused to grant them permission.
Australian law prohibits girls under the age of 18 from marrying unless there are exceptional circumstances.
Willis had said she wanted to marry Cooper before her 18th birthday on May 1 in case her child, due in early June, came early and was born out of wedlock.
The couple appealed to the Supreme Court, which found the magistrate had applied too strict a test, and permission was eventually given in the magistrates' court on Friday.
"It's unbelievable. We're just really happy," Willis told reporters outside the court.
The pair, who became engaged last July before Miss Willis became pregnant, said they had received wide public support.
